From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of needs (as I captured them)
- Primary: private deployment options (VPC, customer-managed VPC peering, and potential on-prem/air-gapped builds)
- Compliance: SOC 2 status, GDPR applicability for EU customers, potential HIPAA requirements in future product lines
- Vendor Questionnaire: your procurement/security team needs a completed vendor security questionnaire and a high-level deployment diagram

Questions I had / action items for ACME
- Can you confirm current SOC 2 status and expected Type II completion date?
- Confirm whether GDPR obligations apply to the workloads you plan to run (looks like yes for EU users) and any special data residency requirements
- Is HIPAA required for any current/pending workloads? If not now, is it on the roadmap?
- Please share a network topology or diagram (a simple PNG/PDF is fine) that shows where you'd like Redwood to sit (VPC peering, transit gateway, on-prem DMZ, etc.)

What I’m sending you now
- Attached: redwood_vpc_diagram.pdf — a typical private deployment diagram and options (customer-managed VPC peering, PrivateLink, and an on-prem air-gapped outline)
- Attached: vendor_sq_request.xlsx — a short vendor questionnaire we can pre-fill to speed your team

Proposed next steps
1) If you’re ok, fill in the vendor SQ and return — I’ll route answers to our security/compliance and solutions engineering immediately
2) Schedule a 45-minute security deep-dive between your security/infra team and our solutions + security (I’ve CC’d Marissa who can coordinate times)
3) If an on-prem or air-gapped option is being considered, please flag any regulatory/regulatory controls up-front (e.g., physical access, KMS/HSM requirements) so we can prepare a tailored architecture and cost estimate

I’ll follow up later today with possible meeting times. Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and the diagram. Great to see the options laid out. A few answers and context from our side: 

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in 2026; Type II is in progress with an expected completion in March 2028. We can share the Type I report for your review today if useful.
- GDPR: Yes, GDPR applies to a subset of our customers. We have EU-data residency requirements for certain product lines — would need the deployment to be able to pin region or ensure EU-only hosting for those workloads.
- HIPAA: Not required today for the workloads in scope for this project but may be required for a future initiative (timeline TBD).

Vendor SQ: I’ve attached our filled vendor SQ (acme_vendor_sq_filled.xlsx) with answers from procurement. Please note security@acmecorp.com (cc’d) and David Lee (david.lee@acmecorp.com) are the points of contact for security and network architecture follow-up.

Air-gapped / on-prem: We are interested in both customer-managed VPC and a potential on-prem/air-gapped option for a pilot. For air-gapped, we’ll need details on:
- How data ingress/egress is handled (manual transfer or dedicated secure link)
- KMS options (customer-managed keys / HSM)
- Patch/maintenance windows and how updates to the model runtime are applied

I can make time next week for a 45-minute session. My team is available Tuesday (9/21) 10:00–11:30 PT or Wednesday (9/22) 13:00–16:00 PT. If either works, we’ll include David and the security mailbox.

Thanks,
Sarah Johnson
Sr. Product Manager, AI Platforms
ACME Corp
sarah.johnson@acmecorp.com

Sarah — perfect, thank you for the detail and for attaching the filled SQ. Quick confirmation and the plan from our side: 

Confirmations
- Noted SOC 2 Type II expected 2028-03 — please send the Type I report if convenient; our compliance team will review and follow up on any gaps.
- GDPR / data residency: we can support region pinning and EU-only hosting for scoped workloads. We’ll include this as a requirement in the solution brief.
- HIPAA: noted as potential future requirement — we’ll outline what additional controls and timeline would look like if/when that’s needed.

Immediate next steps (I’ll own coordination)
1) I’ll route your completed SQ to our security/compliance team and attach the answers back with their notes — expect an internal security response within 3 business days.
2) Proposed meeting: Tuesday 2027-09-21 10:30–11:15 PT (I suggested 45 minutes; we can compress to 45). Marissa (cc’d) will send a calendar invite if that works for you.
3) For air-gapped/on-prem pilot: Laura (cc’d — solutions engineering) will prepare a short options doc that covers data ingress/egress patterns, KMS/HSM approaches, and patching/update procedures. I’ve asked her to include rough timelines and a checklist of required customer-side capabilities.

I’ve uploaded an updated VPC diagram and an internal checklist here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/acme-vpc-diagram — we’ll update with any specifics you share. For tracking, I’ve added this to DEAL-4832.

If you can also share a simple network topology PDF (showing subnets, VPN/transit gateway, and any appliance IP ranges) before the meeting, that’ll make the session much more efficient.

Thanks again — Marissa will follow up with the invite and Laura will share the options doc ahead of the meeting.

Best,
